status: offline interface and training-batch demonstration only
T: sum over all operations of maximum alternative processing time
C: sum over jobs of maximum alternative count among that job's operations
remaining_work_population: unfinished jobs only, including current unscheduled operation; shortest alternative durations
H_status: hand-written fixed demo; not formal EoH-S H
fitness: arithmetic mean over all train instances of -makespan / LB; larger is better
LB: max(longest job shortest-work sum, total shortest-work sum / machine_count)
LB_difference_from_frozen_Tier1: no ceiling on load term, following literal V5 definition; do not mix scores across versions
invalid_candidate: any failed instance invalidates the full U; mean_training_fitness=null; no subset averaging, retry or fallback
validation_purpose: future final U selection; not evaluated here
test_purpose: future independent reporting after U/H/protocol are fixed; not evaluated here
execution_scope: trusted deterministic hand-written Python only; no sandbox or timeout enforcement
